description: Transparent opportunity scoring. Each component is 0-100 (higher = more favourable). Components without enough input are left null and excluded from the weighted average; they are never imputed. A high score is NOT a probability of financial success.

confidence_rules.unvalidated: evidence_quality < 40 OR fewer than 3 supporting items OR fewer than min_components_for_score components
confidence_rules.medium: evidence_quality 60-79 AND at least 2 analyst-rated components
confidence_rules.high: evidence_quality >= 80 AND all components present AND status = validated
